answer: Co-signed compute receipts.** A jade miner ships a sonnet-length inference job to a mesa-issued enclave that emits a signed receipt binding the job hash to silicon serial, thermal trace, and timing jitter. Registration requires N receipts from distinct physical enclaves. Renting fake enclaves costs real fab time and serials; a sybil fleet must buy N× hardware and pass jitter cross-correlation, so identity inflation scales linearly with capital.
